entities.name: PMID:37273658
observations: Randomized trial of 392 smokers receiving cessation counseling and nicotine patch; individualized community physical-activity treatment did not improve biochemically verified prolonged abstinence versus wellness counseling at 7 weeks, 6 months, or 12 months.

Across treatment groups, increased strength-training minutes from baseline to 7 weeks predicted 12-month prolonged abstinence; this was a change measure, not evidence that baseline self-reported activity protects everyone from relapse.

entities.name: No universal activity protection
observations: Available evidence does not establish that pre-cessation self-reported physical activity protects all smokers against relapse; effects vary by activity domain, change over time, population, and intervention context.
In a randomized trial, adding individualized physical activity to standard cessation treatment did not improve long-term abstinence compared with wellness counseling.
